title: Dot Product
statement: Implement `dot(a, b)`, the dot product of two equal-length vectors. Return the sum of elementwise products as a float. This is the similarity score inside linear regression, cosine retrieval, and attention logits.
starter_code:
def dot(a: list[float], b: list[float]) -> float:
    pass
hints: Accumulate x * y into a float sum.
Do not normalize; cosine is a different function.

approaches.name: Single pass
approaches.explanation: One multiply-add per coordinate. This is the inner product BLAS calls gemv and attention both reduce to.

editorial: The dot product a · b = Σᵢ aᵢ bᵢ measures signed alignment. A positive value means the vectors point into the same half-space; zero means they are orthogonal; negative means they oppose. Linear layers, least squares, and attention scores are all built on this reduction. The implementation is a single zip over coordinates. Length mismatches are out of contract here, but production code should assert shapes before the loop.
reference_solution:
def dot(a: list[float], b: list[float]) -> float:
    return float(sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b)))
